scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus approaches along a sunlit village path as Lazarus welcomes him with open arms beside a stone house.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus arriving at Bethany, where Lazarus was, six days before Passover. The verse says Jesus had raised Lazarus from the dead; the greeting and setting are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Martha carries a platter to a low supper table where Jesus, Lazarus, and other guests recline together in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 12:2: a supper is prepared for Jesus, Martha serves, and Lazarus reclines among those with Him. The setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Mary kneels beside Jesus in a warmly lit house, wiping his bare foot with her long hair; an open vessel of oil rests on the rug.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 12:3: Mary anoints Jesus' feet with precious pure nard and wipes them with her hair as the fragrance fills the house. The room and visual details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures as he speaks to Jesus among seated disciples in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Judas Iscariot speaking among Jesus’ disciples; John 12:4 identifies him as the one who was about to betray Jesus. The setting and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures questioningly beside a fragrant oil vessel and coins, while people in simple clothing stand beyond an open doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the verse's question about selling fragrant oil for three hundred denarii and giving the proceeds to the poor; it does not depict the proposed sale or gift as having happened.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man glances aside as he lifts a coin from an open money bag in a sunlit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the theft described in John 12:6: the man kept the money bag and pilfered what was put into it. The room and moment are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus raises a hand toward a man as a woman beside Him holds a small closed vessel in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus asking that she be left alone so she may keep it for the day of His burial; the setting and vessel are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an open hand to a group of attentive people, some in patched clothing, in a sunlit village courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Jesus' contrast between the poor always being with his listeners and his own presence with them not always continuing. The setting and gathering are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A large crowd gathers around Jesus and Lazarus in a sunlit stone courtyard, looking toward the two men.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the crowd coming to see Jesus and Lazarus, whom Jesus had raised from the dead, in John 12:9. The setting and appearances are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Chief priests confer gravely around a table in a stone chamber while a man representing Lazarus walks in a sunlit courtyard beyond the doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the chief priests taking counsel to kill Lazarus also; the setting and figures are visual interpretations rather than details specified by John 12:10.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of people walk along a sunlit village path toward Jesus, who welcomes them with open hands.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting the people going away and believing in Jesus in John 12:11. The verse does not specify the pictured setting or gestures.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A large crowd gathers outside Jerusalem's stone walls as people share news and listeners turn toward them in warm morning light.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the festival crowd hearing that Jesus is coming to Jerusalem, as described in John 12:12.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A joyful crowd raises palm branches to greet Jesus as he approaches on a donkey along a sunlit road near a stone town.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 12:13, where people take palm branches, go out to meet him, and shout their welcome. Details of the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits on a young donkey on a sunlit path among olive trees, with hills and a village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus seated on the young donkey he found in John 12:14. The landscape and other visual details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus rides a young donkey toward a sunlit stone city gate as people welcome him with palm branches.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the king coming to Zion seated on a donkey’s colt, expressing the verse’s reassurance not to fear. The setting and welcoming figures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Five disciples gather around an open blank scroll in a sunlit stone room, exchanging thoughtful looks as one gestures; a city lies beyond the doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the disciples later remembering what had been written about Jesus and done to him after he was glorified, though they had not understood at first. The setting and gathering are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An animated crowd gestures toward Jesus and Lazarus beside a sunlit rock-cut tomb, recalling the raising of Lazarus.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative recollection of the event to which the crowd bears witness in John 12:17. The composition combines the witnesses with the raising they remember; its faces, clothing, setting and arrangement are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowd of adults and children gathers around Jesus on a sunlit road, some speaking animatedly and others looking at him with wonder.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the crowd meeting Jesus after hearing that he had done a sign, as described in John 12:18. The setting and gestures are imagined; the sign itself is not depicted.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three Pharisees speak together with concerned expressions while a crowd follows Jesus down a sunlit stone street.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the Pharisees speaking among themselves and observing that the world has gone after him in John 12:19.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilgrims in ancient Mediterranean clothing ascend a sunlit stone path with a crowd toward a temple precinct on a hill.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the Greeks among those coming up to worship at the feast in John 12:20; the appearance of the travelers and setting are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three visitors in a sunlit stone courtyard speak with an attentive man; one gestures with open hands as the others look on hopefully.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the people approaching Philip and asking to see Jesus in John 12:21. The setting, appearances, and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men gesture as they speak with Jesus in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Andrew and Philip telling Jesus, following Philip's telling Andrew in John 12:22. The setting and appearances are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to a small group beneath a tree, with golden light falling around him and hills and a village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus answering that the hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified. The setting and golden light are artistic choices, not details stated in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A lone grain of wheat rests on the soil beside an exposed planted grain with roots and a flourishing cluster of golden wheat heads, in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of Jesus' comparison in John 12:24: a grain remains alone unless it falls into the ground and dies, but if it dies it bears much fruit.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler walks with open hands along a sunlit path, leaving a bundle of possessions and falling leaves behind as he approaches a green valley and distant town.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the traveler leaving possessions behind and walking toward a flourishing landscape as a visual analogy for John 12:25's contrast between loving one's life in this world and keeping it for eternal life. It does not depict a literal event in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks along a sunlit path, turning toward a follower carrying a water jug, amid flowers, trees, and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Jesus' words about serving and following him, being where he is, and the Father's promise to honor his servant. The setting and water jug are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels among rocks and olive trees, one hand over his heart, looking toward light breaking through dark clouds above a winding path and distant hillside town.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Jesus' troubled soul, his address to the Father, and his declaration that he came to this hour for this reason. The landscape and pose are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels beneath an olive tree, hands clasped and face lifted toward golden light breaking through clouds above an ancient city.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus asking the Father to glorify His name and the voice from heaven answering that He has glorified it and will glorify it again. The light suggests the voice visually; the verse does not describe its appearance.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowd gathers around Jesus beneath a tree, looking upward and speaking to one another in surprise, with distant hills and buildings under a partly cloudy sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 12:29: the crowd hears a sound, with some saying it was thunder and others saying an angel spoke to him. Their differing explanations are suggested by their reactions, not shown as visible events.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits outdoors and gestures toward a group of listeners, some of whom look up toward a bright sky over a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Jesus addressing listeners after the voice, reflecting his words in John 12:30 that it came because of them.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed princely figure stumbles out through a walled city's open gate toward a dark landscape, leaving a fallen crown behind as golden light shines over the city.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative image of the judgment of this world and its prince being cast out in John 12:31; the city, figure, and fallen crown are symbolic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A diverse gathering walks toward Jesus, who is lifted on a wooden cross above a sunlit hillside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the verse’s words about being lifted up from the earth and drawing all to himself; the gathering and landscape are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks solemnly to attentive listeners beneath a tree, with a cross-shaped shadow across the ground and a distant city in the sunlit hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking, with the shadow foreshadowing the kind of death he was about to die as described in John 12:33.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man gestures toward Jesus while a crowd watches with thoughtful, questioning expressions.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the crowd questioning Jesus in John 12:34 about the Christ remaining and the Son of Man being lifted up.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to listeners beside a sunlit stone path at dusk, gesturing toward a distant traveler hesitating where the path fades into shadow.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing Jesus' words in John 12:35 about walking while the light is present and the uncertainty of walking in darkness. The setting and traveler are illustrative details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of listeners looks toward warm sunlight in a stone courtyard as Jesus walks into a shaded passage and out of their sight.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Jesus' call to believe in the light and become children of light, followed by his departure and concealment from the people. The setting and appearance are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus holds out his hands in a sunlit stone courtyard as several onlookers gaze skeptically or turn away.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting John 12:37: although Jesus had done many signs before them, they did not believe in Him. The courtyard and people's gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A prophet speaks to attentive listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard as a luminous arm reaches through the clouds.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of Isaiah’s words quoted in John 12:38, evoking the questions of who believed the report and to whom the Lord’s arm was revealed.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly prophet speaks with an open hand to a group of thoughtful, troubled listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes the verse's statement that they could not believe and that Isaiah spoke again; it does not depict a documented meeting.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, people close or cover their eyes as a man holds a stone heart against his chest near an open, light-filled doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes the verse's blinded eyes and hardened heart; the open doorway suggests turning and healing without depicting them as completed.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Isaiah speaks to attentive listeners on a rocky hillside, extending his hand toward golden light streaming through clouds above a distant town.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 12:41: Isaiah spoke concerning Him because he saw His glory. The setting, listeners, and radiant light are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Several richly dressed rulers listen silently to Jesus in a sunlit stone courtyard as three men watch from a synagogue doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting John 12:42: many rulers believed in him but did not confess their belief because of the Pharisees, so they would not be put out of the synagogue.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Richly dressed people smile as a crowd applauds them in a stone courtyard, while a path leads toward a radiant sky behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 12:43's contrast between loving human glory and the glory of God; its people, courtyard, and radiant path are illustrative details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to a group of attentive listeners beneath a tree, raising one hand toward the sky above a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking about believing in him and in the One who sent him; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks beneath a tree while a seated listener looks up at him, golden light falling across a Judean landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a listener's attentive gaze and shared light to suggest Jesus' words that the one beholding him beholds the One who sent him; it does not depict a specified historical setting.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus welcomes a group of people emerging from a shadowed stone street into golden light, with a village and hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the contrast between shadow and light to evoke Jesus coming as light into the world so that everyone believing in him should not remain in darkness. The village and people are artistic interpretation, not details specified by the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to a group beneath a tree as one listener turns away; a sunlit path winds toward a distant village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Jesus' words about one who hears and does not keep his words, and his coming to save the world. The setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus extends a hand toward a man turning away with a raised hand, while a golden path winds toward a distant sunlit town.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays rejecting Jesus and his words. The light leading toward the horizon suggests the enduring word and the last day, when that word will judge.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to a group seated beneath a tree, one hand near his heart and the other extended toward his listeners, with a sunlit stone village beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Jesus' words that he speaks the command given by the Father who sent him; the setting, gestures, and appearances are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an open hand to a group of adults and children seated beneath a leafy tree, with a sunlit path winding through a flowering landscape toward distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking to listeners. The flourishing tree and distant light suggest life as the verse speaks of the Father’s commandment as eternal life and of Jesus speaking as the Father has said to him; the setting and listeners are artistic choices.
